powers.name: Shriek
powers.desc: A loud call that reaches twice as far
powers.how: A pulse that reaches twice as far; everyone within a wide radius startles and may flee, and Still does not hide it.
powers.tip: Use it to map a big room or street at once, or to scatter a crowd so one person is left alone.

powers.name: Mist
powers.how: A silent dash of 2 cells in the direction you move (or face): no footsteps, nobody notices a bump during it, and it stops at walls.
powers.tip: Use it to slip past someone, cross open ground quickly, or escape a startled person.

powers.name: Still
powers.desc: Five quiet seconds, no one notices
powers.how: For 5 seconds your pulses, doors and steps startle no one, and bumping into people goes unnoticed.
powers.tip: Use it to creep up on a target, or to pulse and open doors in a crowded place.

gifts.name: Reserve
gifts.desc: Start next night with 10 more blood
